name: Directed Channeling
body:
You can channel energy in a particular direction.

Prerequisite: Channel energy class feature.

Benefit: When channeling energy, you may change its area of effect to a 60 ft. cone.

Normal: Channeling positive or negative energy is a 30 ft. burst.
